title: Lecture 1 — inequalities, real numbers, and coordinate geometry
summary: Real numbers form an ordered line; inequalities and intervals describe positions and solution sets, absolute value measures distance, and Cartesian coordinates extend distance and slope to the plane.
body: Order on the real line gives inequalities their meaning: adding preserves order, while multiplying by a negative reverses it. Interval notation records complete solution sets, and absolute value measures distance on the line. In the plane, Cartesian coordinates turn horizontal and vertical change into a right triangle, so Pythagoras gives the distance formula, circles fix a distance from a centre, and slope measures rise per unit run.
